LOAN SUMMARY
Oakwood Commons — Synthetic Value Fund II

LENDER: First Western Capital Partners
LOAN AMOUNT: $13,800,000
LOAN TYPE: Fixed Rate Term Loan
INTEREST RATE: 4.25% (fixed)
ORIGINATION DATE: February 15, 2021
MATURITY DATE: February 15, 2026
AMORTIZATION: Interest Only (5 years)
LTV AT ORIGINATION: 75.0%
LENDER FEES: 1.0% ($138,000)

MONTHLY DEBT SERVICE:
Principal: $0 (IO period)
Interest: $48,875
Total Monthly Payment: $48,875
Annual Debt Service: $586,500

FINANCIAL COVENANTS:
Minimum DSCR: 1.25x
Maximum LTV: 80%

DSCR CALCULATIONS (as reported):
Period              NOI         Debt Service    DSCR        Status
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2021 (Y1 Actual)    $892,400    $586,500        1.52x       ✓ PASS
2022 (Y2 Actual)    $1,022,080  $586,500        1.74x       ✓ PASS
2023 (Y3 Actual)    $1,142,000  $943,500*       1.21x       ✗ BREACH
Q1 2023             $285,500    $235,875        1.21x       ✗ BREACH
Q2 2023             $288,200    $238,125        1.21x       ✗ BREACH
Q3 2023             $284,800    $234,750        1.21x       ✗ BREACH
Q4 2023             $283,500    $234,750        1.21x       ✗ BREACH

*2023 debt service increased due to Supplemental Loan draw of $3.2M for renovation program

REMEDIATION PLAN:
- Occupancy improvement: Target 94.5% by Q2 2024
- Rent increases: 4.5% effective Jan 2024
- Expense reduction: Greenfield fee renegotiation (-$50/unit)
- DSCR projected recovery: 1.28x by Q3 2024

NOTES:
- Lender notified June 2023
- Waiver granted through Q4 2023
- Monthly reporting required until covenant compliance restored

Prepared by: Diane Foster, Asset Manager
Date: January 15, 2024
